dedupe_keys.name: australian building energy efficiency register commercial building disclosure downloadable data set

description: The Commercial Building Disclosure (CBD) Downloadable Data Set compiles Australia's entire Building Energy Efficiency Register since its start in 2011 into one downloadable file. The register holds Building Energy Efficiency Certificates (BEECs) disclosed under the CBD program, and a CBD Data Structure Guide explains which columns hold which certificate elements; the data set is described as updated weekly and available only as CSV and ZIP downloads, with users required to accept a disclaimer that the Australian Government does not guarantee accuracy, currency or completeness. The data.gov.au copy was last updated on 4 February 2025 under a Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Australia licence, and an older point dataset covers 2011 to 2019. Coverage: commercial buildings disclosed under the CBD program in Australia. Access: free download from data.gov.au and the CBD site. Licence: CC BY 2.5 AU. Caveats: the cbd.gov.au site did not respond when read here, and only buildings required to disclose are included. Simulation uses are office building energy ratings for commercial stock and benchmarking models. Related records: ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager.
